intro: Unending Torment is an Undercity quest assigned by Master Apothecary Faranell within the Apothecarium. Players assist the Royal Apothecary Society by introducing a caustic Hissing Serum into a dripping contraption positioned over the remains of Othmar. The task serves as enduring retribution for past crimes committed against the Dark Lady.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have concocted a lovely serum that our new guest is sure to find quite... Stimulating.
Take this. Feed it into the workings dripping from above him. Let's see if we can't show him why it's in his best interest to serve loyally.
And try not to drop it. I can't afford a new assistant.

clips.title: Progress
paras: For Othmar's crimes against the Dark Lady, placing him under that oozing specimen is the least he deserves.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent. We'll let his flesh simmer for awhile. Give him time to acclimate to his new home.
I have no further use for the wretch for now, but we shall keep an eye on him. I have many plans for Othmar's future.
